description: Change one seller-owned channel's saved listing scope. Read spellbook_inventory_management_get first. Switching legacy all mode to selected mode clears management for all current listings. On an eligible backfilled account, restore_legacy_all explicitly manages every current and future listing on that connected seller account; saved automation settings remain unchanged. In selected mode, use a named candidateId from current SpellBook Finance rows to manage or stop managing a complete listing. Stopping management leaves its live listing and order history intact. These actions save permission for existing automation and do not enable automation or publish a listing. Usage includes baseUnitAllowance, referralBonusUnits, nominalUnitAllowance, headroom, and overCap.
